_comment: Every track. 'core' is shared by all traditions. A tradition track covers one node of taxonomy/traditions.json (and its children). Status: active (has TRACK.md, track.json and at least one data file) or planned. 'kind' is 'tradition' (default), 'text' (one work, answers keyed to its commentaries; needs commentaries.json) or 'exam' (questions from one institution's or exam system's papers; needs papers.json with permission records). A track's own version lives in its track.json.

tracks.title: Core
tracks.summary: Pan-Buddhist knowledge and correct attribution across every tradition. Owned jointly.
